data.say: Made the house spellings one form: kouza to kōza throughout, Kodan Club to Kōdan Club, and the second *situation* to roman situation, keeping italics for first use only. Left the rest alone on purpose: back versus *back*, tiger versus Tiger, father versus 'Father', reply versus 'reply', and case or possessive forms are different words or sentence positions, not variants; Tiger quote marks at p155 and p179 were left as possibly deliberate echoes rather than title citations.
data.summary: Standardised kōza and Kōdan Club and first-use italics for situation; left homograph and grammatical variants untouched.
